mn133:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Tapodārāme.
mn133:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Samiddhi rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena Tapodo ten' upasaṃkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
mn133:1.4: Tapode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
mn133:1.5: Atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ Tapodaṃ obhāsetvā yen' āyasmā Samiddhi ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā āyasmantaṃ Samiddhiṃ etad avoca:
mn133:2.1: Dhāresi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ cāti?
mn133:2.2: Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca.
mn133:2.3: Tvaṃ pan', āvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ cāti?
mn133:2.4: Aham pi kho, bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca.
mn133:2.5: Dhāresi pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattiyo gāthā ti?
mn133:2.6: Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
mn133:2.7: Tvaṃ pan', āvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā ti?
mn133:2.8: Aham pi kho, bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
mn133:2.9: Uggaṇhāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca;
mn133:2.10: pariyāpuṇāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca;
mn133:2.11: dhārehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca;
mn133:2.12: atthasaṃhito, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddeso ca vibhaṅgo ca ādibrahmacariyako ti.
mn133:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Samiddhi tassā rattiyā accayena yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Samiddhi Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn133:3.2: Idhāhaṃ, bhante, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena Tapodo ten' upasaṃkamiṃ gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
mn133:3.3: Tapode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsiṃ gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
mn133:3.4: Atha kho, bhante, aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā . . .
mn133:4.15: Sādhu me, bhante, Bhagavā bhaddekarattassa uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca desetūti.
mn133:4.16: Tena hi, bhikkhu, suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmīti. --
mn133:4.17: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Samiddhi Bhagavato paccassosi.
mn133:6.2: Idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāram pāvisi.
mn133:7.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:--
mn133:7.2: Idaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn133:7.19: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajjeyyāti?
mn133:7.20: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
mn133:7.21: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ;
mn133:7.22: pahoti c' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
mn133:7.23: Yan nūna mayaṃ yen' āyasmā MahāKaccāno ten' upasaṃkameyyāma upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kaccānaṃ etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmāti?
mn133:7.24: Atha kho te bhikkhū yen' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmatā Mahā-Kaccānena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
mn133:7.25: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kaccānaṃ etad
mn133:7.26: avocuṃ:-Idaṃ kho no, āvuso Kaccāna, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn133:7.31: Tesan no, āvuso Kaccāna, amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
mn133:7.32: Idaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn133:8.1: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti?
mn133:8.2: Tesan no, āvuso Kaccāna, amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
mn133:8.3: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito . . .
mn133:9.1: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanañ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikamm' eva mūlaṃ atikamma khandhaṃ sākhapalāse sāram pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya, --
mn133:9.2: evaṃ sampadam idaṃ. -- Āyasmantānaṃ Satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ Bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etam atthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññetha
mn133:9.3: So h', āvuso, Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī Tathāgato.
mn133:9.4: So c' eva pan' etassa kālo hoti yaṃ Bhagavantaṃ yeva etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha. Yathā vo Bhagavā byākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyathāti.
mn133:10.2: kālo hoti yaṃ Bhagavantaṃ etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāma.
mn133:10.3: Yathā no Bhagavā byākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma.
mn133:10.4: Api c' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvannito saṃbhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ;
mn133:10.5: pahoti c' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena attham avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
mn133:11.1: Tena h', āvuso, suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti. --
mn133:11.2: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahā-Kaccānassa paccassosuṃ. --
mn133:12.1: Yaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn133:12.6: imassa kho ahaṃ, āvuso, Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.

mn133:19.1: Yaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn133:19.6: imassa kho 'haṃ, āvuso, Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.

mn133:19.8: Yathā vo Bhagavā byākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.

mn133:20.2: Yaṃ kho no, bhante, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn133:20.7: tesan no, bhante, amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato. etad ahosi:
mn133:20.8: Idaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesam uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā vihāram paviṭṭho:
mn133:20.25: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti?
mn133:20.26: Tesan no, bhante, amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
mn133:20.27: Ayaṃ kho, āvuso, Mahā-Kaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito . . . etam
mn133:20.30: Atha kho mayaṃ, bhante, yen' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno ten' upasaṃkamimhā, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ MahāKāccānaṃ etam atthaṃ paṭipucchimhā.
mn133:20.31: Tesan no, bhante, āyasmatā Mahā-Kaccānena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi attho vibhatto ti.
mn133:21.1: Paṇḍito bhikkhave Mahā-Kaccāno mahāpañño bhikkhave Mahā-Kaccāno.
mn133:21.2: Mañ ce pi tumhe, bhikkhave, etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, aham pi taṃ evam evaṃ byākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ Mahā-Kaccānena byākataṃ.
mn133:21.3: Eso c' eva tassa attho evañ ca naṃ dhārethāti.
mn133:21.5: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun
